# Updatepackages

The updates the package index has for the host.

## Where it is served

| Surface | Where |
| ------- | ----- |
| API | `/api/node/{hostname}/updatepackages`, in [API](/category/api) |
| CLI | `osapi client node updatepackages` |
| Jobs | `behavior.updatepackages.<method>`, run by the agent |

## Built on

| Uses | Used by |
| ---- | ------- |
| Nothing | Nothing |

## Where it runs

On `debian`. On any other platform its methods report `skipped`.

`list` runs `apt`, only where it runs.

`update` runs `apt-get` with sudo, only where it runs.

In a trace, a call is the span `behavior.updatepackages.<method>`, with `exec apt-get`, `exec apt` under it.

## Methods

| Method | Verb | Permission | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ---------- | ----------- |
| [`list`](../../usage/cli/client/node/updatepackages/list.md) | read | `updatepackages:read` | List the packages the index has newer versions of |
| [`update`](../../usage/cli/client/node/updatepackages/update.md) | write | `updatepackages:write` | Refresh the package index |

## Settings

None. A behavior declares settings with `behavior.Config`.
